description: Source code for user login and session management in Mattermost, including authentication, session creation, cookie handling, and CWS login logic.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for user authentication, session management, and cookie handling.

methods.name: AuthenticateUserForLogin
methods.description: Authenticates a user for login, handling CWS tokens and standard credentials.

methods.name: GetUserForLogin
methods.description: Retrieves a user based on login ID or LDAP, considering configuration settings.

methods.name: DoLogin
methods.description: Creates a session for the user, sets cookies, and triggers login hooks.

methods.name: AttachCloudSessionCookie
methods.description: Sets a cloud workspace URL cookie based on the domain.

methods.name: AttachSessionCookies
methods.description: Sets session, user, and CSRF cookies, and attaches cloud session cookie if applicable.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Determines if the request is over HTTPS or HTTP.

methods.name: isCWSLogin
methods.description: Checks if a token indicates a CWS login in a cloud environment.
